Pokémon Day 2026 is upon us, and it’s a special one.

This year’s celebration marks the franchise’s 30th anniversary , and plenty of Pokémon fans have been gearing up by watching out for the latest news on their favorite pocket monsters, along with stalking websites for deals on Pokémon product , of which there are many. One such deal that has gone viral is on a Pokémon Trading Card Game available at Walmart. The Mega Evolution Ascended Heroes Elite Trainer Box is 11% off, just $133.95 now, and comes with everything aspiring trainers need to grow their card collection and battle against other trainers.

The box comes with nine Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution Ascended Heroes booster packs — that’s randomized card packs — along with one full-art foil promo card featuring N’s Zekrom
65 card sleeves, 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards, a player’s guide to the Mega Evolution-Ascended Heroes expansion for new and returning players, six damage-counter dice and one competition-legal coin-flip die. With your purchase, you’ll also get a collector’s box to hold everything with six dividers to keep your box organized and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live which is  a free-to-play, digital, turn-based card game available on PC, Mac and mobile.

Pokémon’s battling system is pretty in-depth. The basics for new players are quite simple: Two players use a 60-card deck to knock out six of your opponent’s Pokémon to win, collecting a Prize card each time you defeat one. Players will take turns attaching Energy to Pokémon, evolving them to stronger forms and using Trainer cards to attack with the goal of taking all six Prize cards first. To set up a game, each player starts with seven cards and places six cards face-down as Prize cards. You place one Basic Pokémon in the “Active” spot and up to five on your “Bench” to call in later. Pokémon’s official website has an in-depth guide on how to play.

While a lot of people collect to play against others, many also collect to trade or sell cards at shows and conventions. In the sleeves or booster packs seen in this trading card game, you’ll get random cards that may include rare cards identified by specific symbols such as stars, gold stars or numbering higher than the set total. They might also have unique features such as holographic foils or special artwork.

Recently, Pokémon celebrated its 30th anniversary with the help of musicians such as Lady Gaga and BLACKPINK’s JISOO in a commercial that aired during the Super Bowl. In the commercial, Gaga and JISOO shared their favorite Pokémon — Jigglypuff and Eevee, respectively.
